name: ShKH vz. 77 DANA
protection: Light armour on cab and turret halves. Game: immune to 5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51; 7.62x54R and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable wheels, engine and optics; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Tatra 815 8x8 truck chassis: armoured cab at the front, engine at the rear
Turret split into two separate armoured halves left and right of the gun, open channel between them for the recoiling barrel
Long barrel over the cab in travel, roof crane for ammunition
Polish and Georgian vehicles in three-colour camouflage
